title: Independent source repair check: Tshivenda completion controls

lexicalEvidence.evidence: Swayani khona ... — imperative used for marking corners.

lexicalEvidence.source: DBE Grade 2 Tshivenda HL Exemplar Questions, printed page 9 (PDF page 10)
lexicalEvidence.evidence: “Swayani nga (x) kha tshibogisi tsini na phindulo yone.” This supports the imperative lexeme only, not fluent UI approval.

sourceBinding.displayCondition: button visible text when module is not done

rows.previousCandidate: Tshwayani uri modulu iyi yo fhela
rows.correctedCandidate: Swayani uri modulu iyi yo fhela
rows.literalBackTranslation: Mark that this module is finished/complete.
rows.reason: The exact respectful imperative “Swayani” occurs in current Tshivenda locale instructions for marking each corner (lib/locales/ve.ts:150-151, 219), and the external Grade 2 Tshivenda exemplar supplied by the root independently shows “Swayani nga (x) kha tshibogisi…”. The predicate “yo fhela” matches the approved Tshivenda status labels “Yo fhela” (Complete) and “Zwo fhela” (Done). Thus the clause explicitly marks the module completion state.
rows.priorRationaleCorrection: Remove the earlier claim that Tshwaya/Tshwayani was present in the locale. The actual local imperative is Swayani; the corrected candidate uses it.
rows.remainingRisk: This checks semantic composition only. Confirm the module-subject agreement, the negative toggle wording, and the naturalness of the whole UI clause with a fluent Tshivenda reviewer; the word evidence does not approve interface fluency.

sourceBinding.displayCondition: aria-label when done=true; toggles completion off

rows.previousCandidate: Tshwayani uri modulu iyi a yo ngo fhela
rows.correctedCandidate: Swayani uri modulu iyi a yo ngo fhela
rows.literalBackTranslation: Mark that this module is not finished/complete.
rows.reason: The source is shown only when the module is currently marked done and the action reverses that state. It uses the same locally anchored mark imperative and completion predicate, with explicit negation. The `a yo ngo` pattern is also present in current Tshivenda wording such as “Phindulo a yo ngo luga”.
rows.priorRationaleCorrection: Remove the earlier claim that Tshwaya/Tshwayani was present in the locale. The actual local imperative is Swayani; the corrected candidate uses it.
rows.remainingRisk: This checks semantic composition only. Confirm the module-subject agreement, the negative toggle wording, and the naturalness of the whole UI clause with a fluent Tshivenda reviewer; the word evidence does not approve interface fluency.
